column1: # NPC skater natural stance per character record (doc 26, "NPC skater natural stance").
# Our own measurement table, not a game file: retail keeps the stance in the character records
# (class 91BCA6693EFC9AA7, byte +120: 1 = regular, 0 = goofy; GetCACSettings 82590B50), which the
# setup does not export yet. Values were read from the recomp at NPC construction (ten idle runs,
# 426 spawns, 0 conflicts; runs cas_pcu1, cas_mp1, cas_ind1, cas_dt2, cas_un2, cas_in2, cas_un3,
# meaning is user-confirmed (2026-10-08): the player's created
# skater (CAC_female) reads +120 = 0 and rides goofy in game.
# Columns (tab separated): record name, record id (hex, - = not seen), stance, evidence.
# stance: regular | goofy | unknown (unknown = engine default, goofy like the stock rig).
# evidence: measured (read at construction) | inferred (slot refill without a new read: the
# previous occupant's value) | unseen (did not spawn in the runs).
# [trace] first runs (cas_pcu1, cas_mp1, cas_ind1); john_cardiel / john_rattray measured later (cas_dt2, cas_in2, cas_un2).
# [trace] cas_dt2 (Downtown: Rosalita Skate Park, Carverton Memorial Park, Midtown Promenade, Tresoutta Plaza).
# [trace] cas_un2 (University: Hartley Stadium, The Carvatron, Chan Center, The Observatory).
# [trace] cas_in2 (Industrial: Miracle Bowl, The Old Factory, Carverton Quarry, Haystings Park).
# [trace] cas_un3 (University: Campus Entrance, Clock Tower, Daly Estates, Peterson Pavilion), cas_dt3 (Downtown:
# Kube Tower, Plaza of Solitude, Uptown Promenade, Park'n'Play), cas_in3 (Industrial: Drydocks, Factory Roofs, Loading
# Docks, Pipe Works, The Tanker); jerry_hsu measured in cas_in3. cas_dt4 (Aletown, All Mart, Crystal Towers, Hotel
# District, Rippon Towers) added no record.
# Free-roam pool records that did not spawn in the runs (stance unknown, engine default).
# community_skater_01..05 need online play (vault gate "offline"; the choice skips community ids unless
# allowed), so offline runs cannot spawn them; their look and stance came from uploaded profiles.
